title: DANDI Compute LFP Extraction Parameters
description: One complete set of LFP extraction parameters, as stored in a file under the pipeline's `params/` directory. Every field is required, so a parameters file always states the whole configuration rather than leaning on defaults applied somewhere else.

filter_family.description: Filter design family, forwarded to SpikeInterface `bandpass_filter` as `ftype`.

filter_band.description: The (freq_min, freq_max) bandpass edges in Hz, forwarded to SpikeInterface `bandpass_filter`. Corresponds to the AIND `lfp.filter.{freq_min, freq_max}` fields, but restricted here to a fixed set of bands, each written low edge first.

filter_order.description: Filter order, forwarded to SpikeInterface `bandpass_filter` as `filter_order`. Corresponds to the AIND highpass filter order, restricted here to a fixed set.

filter_direction.description: Whether the bandpass filter runs as a single causal pass or a zero-phase forward-backward pass.

resample_target_fs.description: Target LFP sampling frequency in Hz, forwarded to SpikeInterface `resample`. Corresponds to the AIND `lfp.sampling_rate` field, restricted here to a fixed set.

spatial_factor.description: Spatial decimation factor. 1 keeps every channel, 4 keeps every fourth channel ordered by depth. Corresponds to the AIND `lfp_spatial_factor` field.

bad_channel_method.description: The bad channel detection method applied before filtering.
